gen.title: How to determine lift and drag from a test flight

steps.label: tan(a) = h / d
steps.orderHint: measure then calculate then balance forces

steps.label: weight W
steps.quote: The lift L times the cosine cos of the glide angle plus the drag D times the sine sin of the glide angle is equal to the weight W:
steps.orderHint: measure then calculate then balance forces

steps.label: drag times the cosine of the glide angle
steps.quote: The lift times the sine of the glide angle is equal to the drag times the cosine of the glide angle.
steps.orderHint: measure then calculate then balance forces

steps.label: experimentally determine the lift and drag
steps.quote: With these three equations we can experimentally determine the lift and drag of a glider.
